title: Sweep the Trail
shareTitle: Sweep the Trail — A Cozy Forest Sweeping Game
description: Sweep soft leaves, rolling acorns, and tiny crumbs into their tidy homes in a handcrafted felt forest.
summary: Guide a broad felt broom through three no-fail trails and help a squirrel care for each cozy place.
learningGoals: Approach a target from behind and push objects toward it
Adjust stroke length for light, heavy, and tiny debris
Build practical-life confidence through gentle place care
interactionModel: choose a trail, drag a large raster broom through loose pieces, and sweep each piece into a visible basket or dustpan with forgiving target assist
feedbackModel: responsive piece movement, tactile capture animation and sound, visual progress, recorded squirrel-guide coaching, idle nudges, and a no-fail felt-puppet celebration

modes.title: Leaf Lane
modes.skill: broad gentle sweeps with light leaves

modes.title: Acorn Bend
modes.skill: repeat nudges for heavier rolling acorns

modes.title: Porch Path
modes.skill: short controlled strokes with tiny crumbs
